classification_rationale: The customer is complaining about a delivery arriving at the wrong time, a delivery-logistics complaint that stays routine regardless of the frustrated tone.

draft.reply_body:
Hello Esko,

I'm sorry to hear the delivery timing on your last rental cost you a chunk of your day - that's not the experience we want for a customer who's been with us since 2016. I've passed this on to the depot's scheduling team so they can look into what went wrong.

I'm not able to offer compensation for the time lost from this end, but I wanted to acknowledge it properly rather than let it go unanswered. If you'd like to discuss it further, let me know and I'll get someone from the depot to call you.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Apologised for the delivery scheduling issue and escalated it internally to the depot's scheduling team for review; no compensation offered as no policy basis applies to a scheduling delay of this kind
